svg.title: One scheme for every role: the server flight
svg.desc: Server first flight with the same scheme in every role: ECDSA 2,930 bytes; SNOVA 5,717; Falcon-512 7,515; MAYO-1 7,555; Falcon-1024 12,384; MAYO-2 13,199; ML-DSA-44 17,169; MQOM 17,145; ML-DSA-65 22,916; ML-DSA-87 30,786; SLH-DSA-128s 41,833. Only ECDSA and SNOVA fit the QUIC budget of about 7,200 bytes; Falcon, MAYO fit the TCP window of 14,600.
